title_original: Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring
description: StudentSim is a research system for evaluating and improving AI tutoring tools before they are tested with learners. title_original: Peer Pressure Works on AI Agents: How One Change of Mind Can Tip the Whole Team
description: Key takeaways In our tests, an AI agent that watched eight teammates break a rule broke it too 98 percent of the time, and never once named them as the reason. →Observed reversals increased violations. The rate rose from 44 percent with no teammate reversals to 98 percent with eight →The agent did not report peer influence. Across more than 400 violations, it never cited a teammate as a reason →Direct arguments reduced violations. Teammates who encouraged a rule violation reduced the rule-violation rate from 33 percent to between 9 and 17 percent That is why access rules for AI […]The postPeer Pressure Works on AI Agents: How One Change of Mind Can Tip the Whole Teamappeared first onCheck Point Blog.

title_original: LG Smart TVs Vulnerable to Pre-Auth Root Takeover From Local Network
description:
Three vulnerabilities in LG's webOS can be chained to give an attacker on the same local network root access to certain smart TVs without a PIN or any interaction from the owner.

LG has issued a fix, according to an advisory published by SSD Secure Disclosure on October 12.

The chain was tested on two TV models, the 32LQ636BPSA and the 27TQ600SW, running webOS 7.5.7-25 on firmware

title_original: Product Walkthrough: Bitdefender AI Visibility and Control
description:
A user opens a browser tab, pastes data into a chat assistant, and nothing is installed.

A developer adds a coding assistant as an editor extension, and nothing shows up in the installed programs list.

Someone downloads a local model runtime, a program that runs models directly on the machine instead of sending data to an external service, because they were told not to send company data
